connector.name: Lunch Money
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for managing LunchMoney personal finances: transactions, budgets, categories, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package lunchmoney-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the akutishevsky account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
